exposure: Management strategies for pregnant women with VP (including hospitalization and timing of planned CS)
cohort: The study surveyed 351 cases of pregnant women diagnosed with vasa previa (VP) from 109 perinatal centers across Japan.
finding: Current management strategies for vasa previa in responding Japanese perinatal centers appear to result in good perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The timing of planned cesarean section for vasa previa was typically at 36 (range 33.5-39) weeks of gestation, and emergency cesarean section was required in 25.4% of cases.
cross-section timing: Data on VP cases were collected for the period between January 2020 and December 2022.
gest_age: Routine hospitalization for VP was initiated at a median of 32 (range 22-36) weeks of gestation, and planned cesarean section was performed at a median of 36 (range 33.5-39) weeks of gestation.
